newsitem.title: GERMANY: BERLIN CHANGES NAZI-ERA STREET NAME.
newsitem.headline: BERLIN CHANGES NAZI-ERA STREET NAME.

text.p: The Nazi-era name of a Berlin street leading to the stadium where Hitler's Third Reich hosted the 1936 Olympics is to be changed despite residents' complaints, city authorities said on Friday.
Reichssportfeldstrasse (Reich Sports Field Street) is being renamed because of associations with the Nazi regime.
A court last week rejected residents' complaints that the change involved effort and cost on their part. The city did not say how it had chosen the new, uncontroversial name -- Flatow Avenue.
